description: Pay for, renew, upgrade or cancel a deployed agent's plan, or buy extra credits. Charges come from the Wiro wallet of the agent's workspace (the team wallet for a team agent); the connected project must belong to that same workspace. Every call without confirm: true only returns what will happen and the amount (for an upgrade, the prorated amount Wiro works out, or the most it can charge when that is worked out only at the upgrade). Show it to the user, get their approval, then repeat the call with confirm: true and confirm_charge_usd set to the quoted amount (for an upgrade, quote.maxChargeUsd); if the price changed in between, nothing is charged and a new quote comes back. Never repeat a confirmed charge that failed or timed out without checking get_my_agent first. subscribe starts a plan for an agent without one; renew undoes a cancellation or renews an expired wallet plan; upgrade_to_pro charges the prorated difference now; buy_credits adds a credit pack (Pro only); cancel stops renewals with no refund. Plans renew every 30 days until cancelled. Renewals, upgrades and packs leave a running agent running. An agent whose plan is billed by card is upgraded and topped up in the Wiro dashboard, and a personal card plan is cancelled there; the tool returns the link and charges nothing. A card plan that is moving to wallet billing pays upgrade_to_pro and buy_credits from the wallet, and cancel works once the wallet bills it. On a team agent only a team admin, the organization's owner or the person who deployed the agent can pay for it or change its plan; other members are refused and nothing is charged.

action.description: subscribe, upgrade_to_pro, cancel, renew or buy_credits.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents or deploy_agent.

confirm.description: false returns only the quote. true performs the action. Set it only after the user approved it.

confirm_charge_usd.description: With confirm: true, the amount the user approved, from the quote's nextAction (quote.chargeNowUsd, or quote.maxChargeUsd for upgrade_to_pro). Required for every action that charges: subscribe, upgrade_to_pro, buy_credits and renewing an expired plan. If a fresh quote no longer matches it, nothing is charged and the new quote is returned. For upgrade_to_pro it is the most the user agreed to pay now.

pack.description: buy_credits only: the credit pack to buy. Leave it out to get the packs with their credits and prices.

request_id.description: buy_credits only: the id returned by the quote. Repeating a purchase with the same id never charges twice. Every new purchase needs a new quote; an id whose purchase already completed buys nothing.

tier.description: subscribe only: the tier to pay for (default: the agent's current tier).

name: manage_agent_billing

monthly.description: The monthly credits this period grants. A plan change inside a period moves it for the time left, so it can differ from renewal.

renewal.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants.

lastActivityAt.description: When the agent's newest message was written, on any channel, scheduled runs included. Left out when it has none.

setupRequired.description: Whether the agent waits for setup. list_my_agents goes by the status (6). get_my_agent also checks each required credential and names what is missing.

amountUsd.description: What the plan costs every 30 days. For a plan that has ended, the agent's monthly price, which is what a renew charges.

atPeriodEnd.description: For an active plan, what happens at periodEndsAt: it renews, it ends, or unknown for a card plan whose renewal is managed in the Wiro dashboard.

creditsNow.description: upgrade_to_pro: the credits this period gains now, below 0 when it loses them. monthlyCredits is what every renewal gives.
upgrade_to_pro: the credits this period gained with it, below 0 when it lost them. monthlyCredits is what every renewal gives.

title: Manage a Wiro agent's plan and credits
